# IslamicHub

> Free, open-source Islamic education and utility platform combining authentic guides to the Five Pillars with practical tools (prayer times, Qibla finder, Zakat calculator, inheritance engine, daily adhkar, tasbih) and a hadith library.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://islamichub.xyz/): Overview, today panel, prayer times preview, pillars, and tools
- [The Five Pillars](https://islamichub.xyz/pillars): What the five pillars of Islam are, with a guide to each
- [Tools](https://islamichub.xyz/tools): Every calculator, tracker and counter on the site in one place
- [Games](https://islamichub.xyz/games): A prophets quiz, a guessing game on the prophets, and a daily Qur'anic word puzzle, each answer with its evidence
- [Prophets Quiz](https://islamichub.xyz/games/quiz): Ten random questions on the lives of the prophets from a bank of 300, each with its evidence
- [Kalimah](https://islamichub.xyz/games/kalimah): A daily word from the Qur’an to guess in Arabic letters or transliteration, shown in its verse afterwards
- [Who Am I?](https://islamichub.xyz/games/who-am-i): Guess the prophet from clues drawn from his story, each with its evidence
- [Faith (Shahada)](https://islamichub.xyz/faith): Shahada guide, conditions of validity, Tawhid dimensions, Risala
- [Six Articles of Faith](https://islamichub.xyz/faith/articles): Belief in Allah, angels, books, messengers, the Last Day, and divine decree
- [Prayer (Salah)](https://islamichub.xyz/prayer): Daily prayer times, Qibla finder, guides to the prayer, conditions, and rak'ah guide
- [How to Pray](https://islamichub.xyz/prayer/how-to-pray): Each position of the prayer illustrated, with what to recite in Arabic, transliteration and translation
- [The Adhan](https://islamichub.xyz/prayer/adhan): The call to prayer and the iqamah with meanings, how the first adhan began, and what to say when hearing it
- [Zakat](https://islamichub.xyz/zakat): Zakat calculator with gold/silver Nisab and currency exchange, conditions, and recipients
- [Fasting (Sawm)](https://islamichub.xyz/fasting): Ramadan tracker, fasting conditions, exemptions, and virtues
- [Hajj](https://islamichub.xyz/hajj): Five-day Hajj rites, Umrah guide, conditions of obligation, and types of Hajj
- [Hadith Library](https://islamichub.xyz/hadith/books): Nine canonical hadith collections with Arabic, English, and grade ratings
- [Inheritance Calculator](https://islamichub.xyz/inheritance): Fara'id inheritance calculator computing Quranic fixed shares and residuary distribution
- [Adhkar](https://islamichub.xyz/adhkar): Morning, evening, after prayer, and sleep adhkar with Arabic text, translation, and counters
- [Duas](https://islamichub.xyz/duas): Supplications from the Quran and Sunnah organised by situation
- [Prayer Tracker](https://islamichub.xyz/tracker): Daily, weekly, and monthly prayer tracking on-device
- [Tasbih](https://islamichub.xyz/tasbih): Digital tasbih counter with vibration feedback and daily totals
- [Prophets](https://islamichub.xyz/prophets): The 25 prophets named in the Quran with their stories, and Ibrahim's journey map
- [Eid](https://islamichub.xyz/eid): Guide to Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha with next-Eid countdown
- [Qurbani](https://islamichub.xyz/qurbani): Eid al-Adha sacrifice guide with shares helper
- [About](https://islamichub.xyz/about): Project mission, methodology, open source info, and privacy settings
